task: Investigate Chinese diesel allocations ahead of October, official-site meaning differences, downstream service exposure and freight electrification.

answer.summary: October allocation, diesel-specific permissions and actual arrival cover remain unverified. Published truck policies establish an electrification push but not deployed October capacity. The English/Chinese subsidy comparison preserves consistent priority and a summary-length omission, not a contradiction.
counterevidence: Reported August export growth is a lead against a monotonic deterioration hypothesis.
Alternative shipments, inventory and substitution may buffer a permission reduction.
limitations: No official October diesel quantity verified in the bounded search.
Direct customs monthly-page access timed out.
Policy records are not operational stock, disbursement or route-performance measurements.
No matched October export-language pair; the actual comparison concerns truck policy.
English policy digest is an editorial summary, not a certified translation.

comparison.match_basis: Same 2026 commercial-truck replacement program, agencies, electric priority and central/local funding mechanism. English digest omits document number; it is an account of the policy, not an official translation.
comparison.original_short: 优先支持更新为电动货车
comparison.english_pivot: Give priority to replacement with electric trucks.
comparison.control: Both accounts preserve electric priority and the funding boundary.
comparison.difference: Prior-year funding-gap details in the full Chinese notice are absent from the short English account.
ordinary_explanations: English item is a later news digest
comparison.operational_question: Can an eligible carrier receive the subsidy and charging access in time to replace working freight capacity?

sample_for_jared.title: Who carries the gap?
sample_for_jared.text: The two accounts agree on electric priority. The longer notice raises a practical next question: when does the support become cash that lets a carrier finish the change?
sample_for_jared.control: Consistent policy wording across the notice and digest; missing administrative detail is not proof of concealment.

watch_protocol.october_focus: Chinese diesel allocation, actual deliveries, official wording and freight electrification
watch_protocol.confirmation: Reduced cargoes plus insufficient compatible replacement before accessible stock cover expires; name the receiving service and interval.
watch_protocol.falsification: Timely replacement deliveries or tested substitution maintain service; explain the tested location and period.
watch_protocol.stop_rule: No run-out date, donor reserve or October quantity from an allocation headline alone.

resilience.buffers: Compatible usable inventory and confirmed arriving cargoes; quantities unknown.
resilience.safe_shedding: Consolidate optional trips and use backhauls while protecting essential access and food handling.
resilience.adaptation_growth: A tested depot-return route, shared charging and repair capability; no operator commitment.
resilience.lifeboat: A verified alternative carrier or compatible rail/electric service; spare capacity unknown.
resilience.outside_support: Require export authority, donor capacity after commitments, route access and receiving compatibility.
resilience.commons: Opt-in shared delivery/backhaul board; no private recipient data or claimed partner.

reflection.summary: Permission, policy support and completed service need separate evidence. Official-language comparison helped identify a practical funding question without manufacturing a contradiction.
observations: Full notices and short summaries can agree while exposing different operational details.
The food-cover denominator gap recurs in fuel arrivals and usable electric-freight capacity.
suggestions: Preserve product, trade direction, date and denominator before comparing amounts.
Prefer a dated payout or shipment record for the next bounded check.
questions: Which October permission can be paired with a corresponding shipment and a receiving-stock observation?
uncertainties: October allocation and usable donor/export capacity remain unknown.
